l1_connect_account.title: Register the databases still managed by hand
l1_connect_account.why: These databases run production, but the platform does not know them, so their backups, patches and copies are done by hand or not at all.
steps: List the database servers from the infrastructure inventory and compare with the platform's list.
Register each one with a service account that has the documented rights.
Confirm the platform shows its version, size and backup state.
l1_connect_account.success: Every database in scope is registered and reports its backup state.
